Name: EBAGI - Wrong (Opposite) Artisan Good Icons for Vanilla
Author: Shreedle
Description:
[size=4][b]Mod has been fully updated for SDV 1.6+![/b][/size][size=3][b]

[/b][/size]This is an expansion of the EBAGI mod.

It will make an EBAGI-styled image for any Pickles/Jellies/Wines/Juices/Honey made from any vanilla Vegetable/Fruit/Forage item that is not currently supported by EBAGI.

You will need other mods to gain most of these items. For example, you can obtain Blackberry Pickles by using Wrong Keg and Wrong Jar, and
this EBAGI pack will give you an image.

It has EBAGI-style images for the following (including SDV 1.6 items):

-[color=#00ff00]Pickles/Juice[/color]: All Fruits, all Forage, all Flowers, Truffle, Seaweed, Green Algae, White Algae, Sweet Gem Berry, Golden Pumpkin, Moss
-[color=#cc0000]Jelly/Wine[/color]: All Vegetables, all Forage, all Flowers, Truffle, Seaweed, Green Algae, White Algae, Sweet Gem Berry, Golden Pumpkin, Moss
-[color=#ffff00]Honey[/color]: All Fruits, all Vegetables, all Forage, Seaweed, Truffle, Green Algae, White Algae, Sweet Gem Berry, Golden Pumpkin, Moss
-[color=#ff7700]Dried Mushrooms[/color]: Red Mushroom, Truffle

[u]The 1.6+ Forage Pickles are still included?[/u]
Yes, for two reasons: (a) so that anyone that already had this mod and then updates it doesn't get those removed, and (b) I was too lazy to remove them and readjust all the images.

[u]No Dried Fruit or Mead?[/u]
EBAGI does not currently support Dried Fruit or Meads, so there are no icons for those, and I don't believe any Mead icons I had previously made can be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Meads[/url] (though an excellent mod on its own). If anyone updates EBAGI or creates an add-on for Dried Fruit and Mead let me know and I will update this mod. :)

[u]What about other Dried Mushrooms?[/u]
Low-priority since I don't really have a way to differentiate between Dried Mushrooms and Dried Fruit for items. The Dried Mushroom images are designed to match the original EBAGI mod's Dried Mushroom images.

[u]This pack SHOULD be compatible with:[/u]
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15760]Forage, Crops, and Goods Remix[/url] (*)
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15759]Wrong Keg and Wrong Jar[/url] (*)
-[url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10227321]KAYA's Flower Jelly[/url] (*)
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13780]Fruit Tree Honey[/url] (*)[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]
[/url]-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31270]Dried Red Mushrooms and Truffles[/url] (*)
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35890]Floral Wines[/url]﻿ (*)
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4674]More Than Forage[/url]
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14222]Sweet Gem Berry Artisan[/url]
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4679]Sweet Gem Fruit - Rare Rebalance[/url]
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3367]Useful Sweet Gem Berries[/url]
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url]
(*) = Mods I personally tested this mod with to obtain Artisan Goods

...And likely many more! The list above is not exhaustive. :)

If anyone spots any bugs, upload a SMAPI log and let me know, please!

[b][u]To Install:[/u][/b]
1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2) Install [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url].
3) Install mods (like one of those above) which produces some of these items.
3) Download and unzip this mod into your Mods folder.

[b][u]To Uninstall:[/u][/b]
Simply delete the folder for this mod from your Mods folder.

(Interface mod used in images is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14027]Sakura Interface Redux[/url].)

Downloads.Description: Added all Juice icons, new 1.6 item icons, Sap & Moss icons, missing Flower icons, and Dried Mushroom icons for Red Mushroom & Truffle.
